couple-overload#3.text: Can you give me an example?

couple-overload#7.text: That's fair. We can check in on Sunday.

couple-money#7.text: Let's make a plan before deciding.

couple-resentment#3.text: I've tried, but I didn't feel heard.

couple-resentment#7.text: Yes, as long as revisiting means listening, not keeping score.
